FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Asphalt Solutions, Inc. specializes in residential and commercial asphalt paving and repair services. Our core operations include providing high-quality asphalt installation for driveways, parking lots, and roadways, ensuring longevity and durability with our expert craftsmanship. We utilize modern, well-maintained equipment and strict safety protocols to minimize risks and maintain operational efficiency. All of our projects are completed under careful supervision to ensure quality control, and we proudly uphold compliance with local regulations, with no unresolved environmental violations. Our team is trained regularly on equipment usage and safety practices to promote a secure working environment. We take pride in our strong customer relationships and aim for excellence in every project, though we do not engage in subcontracting critical operations without appropriate insurance documentation.

Our asphalt and paving services involve extensive physical labor, including heavy equipment operation and manual handling, which can lead to occasional employee injury claims due to the demanding nature of the work.
